author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Using some extra stock left over from Savage Builds, Adam machines two 1-inch thick tool trays out of cast acrylic for his beloved pantograph mill. Solid acrylic may be overkill for these trays, but that's why you always save your extra material stock for projects like this!

Adam Savage's Pantograph Mill: https://youtu.be/pku2VRADLGk
Adam's Pantograph Mill spanner wrench build: https://youtu.be/PySdrA04M3o
